description: RALEIGH – Cooper for North Carolina launched the “Latino Leaders for Roy” coalition joined by more than 150 leaders and supporters. Latino leaders from across the state joined the launch to discuss how Roy will put North Carolinians first by lowering costs, working to hold health insurance companies that are ripping off working families accountable […]

title: Cooper for North Carolina Launches “Latino Leaders for Roy” Coalition | Roy Cooper for North Carolina
